scope: Permanent official PvE trader quests. Story chapters, standalone Arena tasks and unverified seasonal tasks are not imported.
mergePolicy: Add missing real task IDs; replace Getting Acquainted to repair its predecessor. Keep later upstream real records for other tasks. Never read or write player progress.
objectiveIdPolicy: Existing Getting Acquainted objective IDs are preserved. New local_* goal IDs support manual goal checking and are not game objective IDs. Task IDs are real game IDs.

exclusions.reason: Replace synthetic New Beginning rows with verified real PvE task IDs, without converting personal completion states.
Shifting Balance was explicitly a temporary chain; these missing tasks are not imported as permanent quests.
